To show deals in pounds, change your currency:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Choose **GBP** in the **Currency** list.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

Note that this only changes the symbol shown on every deal. It doesn't convert existing values, so if the amounts need updating, edit each deal's **Value** (numbers only, no currency symbol) and select **Save deal**.
